notes: Pause and resume a recording; mark important moments (⌃⌥M from any app) and type your own notes while recording. In each meeting: marked moments, talk time, and where each to-do was said, with the audio. A follow-up e-mail written for you, a Friday recap of your week, a calendar link (ICS) for Google Calendar or the new Outlook, hesper:// links for Shortcuts or Raycast, and the window can be detached and kept on top.
